cap: Weeks 1 to 3 each have a rule: week 1 moves the conceptus from fertilization in the ampulla to implantation, week 2 makes pairs (two disc layers, two cavities, two trophoblast layers), and week 3 makes the three germ layers. The bar below shows why timing matters for teratogens: all-or-none before week 3, malformations during organogenesis, and growth effects afterward.
